I don't think this level can be won under the rules as written, so I can't give you a winning sequence.

**Why the left door is out of reach:**
- The door at (27,17) sits on a 3x3 island (x 26-28, y 16-18). Row 15 and everything above it is water, and nothing connects that island to the land.
- The nearest land to it is the traders' island around x 42-43, y 25. Crossing takes roughly 20 water cells.
- A hero can only enter water if a sunk crystal or boulder holds the cell up, and each crystal fills one cell. There are only four crystals (#3-#6), and nothing here creates more.

**Why the magic mirror doesn't help:**
- Its two faces see only along row 29 to the west and column 44 to the south. A thing seen at distance k reappears k cells out of the other face, so every reflection lands on row 29 or column 44. None of those cells is near the left island.
- With one mirror there are no copies, so there is still only one trader to place.

**Why layer 1 is unavailable:** the only way up is a gate closing upward, and this level has no gates. Without layer 1, a hero can't step out over water.

Since both traders must stand on doors and the left door is unreachable, the level looks unwinnable. The right door is reachable by land, so a sequence can get one trader there. The other trader cannot get to the left door, so the level still won't win. I haven't verified the exact row widths beyond what the coordinates confirm, so please check the right-side land if you want to pursue a partial solution.

The first step for trader #1 is a safe move north onto floor at (44,27), which doesn't win the level:

It sits on an island about 20 water cells from any land, and the four crystals can fill only four cells. The magic mirror only reflects along row 29 westward and column 44 southward, so it can't ferry a trader there. The level has no gates, so no hero can reach layer 1 and walk over water.

I haven't ruled out a mistake in my reading of the map. The exact row widths are the part I'm least sure of. If you can confirm that the left door island is isolated (rows 15 and above are all water, and nothing connects down to the traders' land), I'd treat the level as unwinnable. If you have a different reading of the water, the mirror, or the crystals, tell me and I'll re-check against it.

I'm not using my last answer. I re-checked the rules for anything I missed, and I still find no way to get a second trader to the left door at (27,17):

- The mirror's reflections only land on row 29 to the west or column 44 to the south, and neither reaches that island.
- With one mirror there are no copies, so there is still only one trader to place.
- The four crystals can fill only four water cells, and the gap is about 20.
- There are no gates, so no hero can reach layer 1 and walk over water.

I also need to correct my earlier message. I said a sequence could get one trader to the right door, but I never checked that route against the map, so I shouldn't have said it.

I believe this level is unwinnable as written. If the map or the mechanics differ from what I've described, send me the corrected details and I'll re-check. Otherwise, the submitted `U` stands as a non-winning placeholder.
